name: San Diego Comic-Con 2027
job: Help prospective attendees understand official badge prices, Preview Night dependency and the dated open-registration process without promising inventory.
facets: July event dates and separate Preview Night
Open registration waiting-room and randomized queue
Per-member badge fee and day pricing
Child-to-junior reference date and on-site child badges
source_notes: Comic-Con lists 22–25 July 2027 with Preview Night 21 July. Open registration 14 November 2026: waiting room 07:30 PST and sale 09:00 PST. Prices and handling fee are published; inventory and eligibility must be verified with organiser.
